Setiap halaman minggu berisi empat bagian: pengantar, hasil belajar, slide kuliah, dan quiz formatif. Bagian terakhir mengarahkan Anda pada evidence yang perlu dimasukkan ke portfolio.

| Minggu | Topik | Bukti utama |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | Communication Is About Persons | Character map |
| 2 | Intra-Self Communication | Reflection journal |
| 3 | Family & Friends | Relationship conversation |
| 4 | Language of Person and Character | Translation portfolio |
| 5 | Working Colleagues | Discovery interview |
| 6 | TAIDA: Target & Attention | Attention pitch |
| 7 | TAIDA: Interest | Problem–solution pitch |
| 8 | UTS Performance Lab | Performance evidence package |
| 9 | TAIDA: Desire | Desired-state conversation |
| 10 | TAIDA: Action | Explicit agreement |
| 11 | Multi-Person Negotiation | Negotiation evidence |
| 12 | Neighbors & Communities | Deliberation evidence |
| 13 | Communicating with the World | Public artifact |
| 14 | AI-Mediated Communication | AI use and boundary design |
| 15 | Capstone | Integrated performance portfolio |
